_comments: COMMON'S ACTION CATEGORY. One row, so MJ: Actions rows resolve a parent by @lookup on Name
rather than baking a UUID into every action.
There was no Common category before this. The ~50 seeded categories are MJ's own connectors
and utilities — none of them is where a Common action belongs. Reusing CRM would read as an
primaryKey from uuidgen so a re-push against a rebuilt database UPDATES this row rather than

fields.Name: Common
fields.Description: Actions belonging to BizApps Common. Common.SyncActivities is the hourly activity-sync trigger; downstream apps register extensions rather than wrapping this.
